prompt:
This image is a painted grand-strategy map seen straight down, with Phong Lâm Trấn painted at its centre. Change ONLY the place at the centre, and only as described; keep its layout, every existing building, the terrain, the water, the colours and the golden-hour light from the top left exactly as they are, so the two images can be swapped on the map.

The place grows one development level: A curved harbour mole runs out under the maples, a two-storey gate tower stands on the sea wall, and the Tạ hall gains an upper storey whose new eaves the swallows fill within a spring.

Keep the change inside a circle about 18 % of the image width across the centre. Never: text, labels, writing, symbols on flags, people larger than specks, a frame, a vignette.
